name: Rose Absolute
odor_description: Deep, rich, honeyed rose with spicy, tea-like undertones
notes: One of the most valuable perfumery ingredients. Bulgarian and Turkish are prized.

name: Jasmine Absolute
odor_description: Rich, warm, floral with animalic, fruity undertones
notes: Indole content gives characteristic animalic note.

name: Tuberose Absolute
odor_description: Intensely floral, creamy, narcotic, with buttery nuances
notes: One of the most expensive floral absolutes. Extremely tenacious.

name: Ylang Ylang Essential Oil
odor_description: Sweet, floral, exotic, with creamy, slightly medicinal notes
notes: Extra grade is finest. Used in Chanel No. 5.

name: Orange Blossom Absolute (Neroli)
odor_description: Fresh, floral, honeyed, with green and slightly animalic notes
notes: Both absolute and distilled (neroli) are used.

name: Lily of the Valley Accord
odor_description: Fresh, green, delicate floral with dewy, aquatic nuances
notes: Cannot be extracted from natural source. Always reconstructed.

name: Violet Leaf Absolute
odor_description: Intense green, leafy, cucumber-like with earthy undertones
notes: Green, not floral. Different from ionone-based violet flower accords.

name: Gardenia Accord
odor_description: Creamy, white floral, coconut-like, with green and mushroom notes
notes: Natural extraction is not commercially viable. Always reconstructed.

name: Magnolia Flower Accord
odor_description: Fresh, citrusy-floral, champagne-like, with lemon and peach notes
notes: Reconstructed from key odorants identified in magnolia headspace.

name: Frangipani Absolute
odor_description: Exotic, creamy, peachy-floral with almond and spicy undertones
notes: Also called Plumeria. Popular in tropical perfumery.

name: Carnation Absolute
odor_description: Spicy, clove-like, honeyed, with green and powdery aspects
notes: Eugenol content gives characteristic clove note.

name: Hyacinth Absolute
odor_description: Intense green-floral, with sweet, heady, almost narcotic quality
notes: Very expensive. Often reconstructed.

name: Iris/Orris Absolute
odor_description: Powdery, violet-like, earthy, with carrot and lipstick notes
notes: Requires 3+ years aging. One of most expensive materials.

name: Mimosa Absolute
odor_description: Powdery, honey-like, with cucumber, violet, and anisic notes
notes: Popular in chypre and fougère compositions.

name: Champaca Absolute
odor_description: Rich, exotic floral with fruity, tea-like, and spicy notes
notes: Used in traditional Indian perfumery (attars).

name: Osmanthus Absolute
odor_description: Fruity-floral, apricot-like, with leathery and raisin notes
notes: Chinese origin. Smells like apricots and leather.

name: Peony Accord
odor_description: Fresh, rose-like with citrus, green, and slightly spicy notes
notes: Cannot be extracted naturally. Reconstructed.

name: Freesia Accord
odor_description: Fresh, peppery-floral, with fruity and green aspects
notes: Light, fresh floral. Reconstructed from headspace analysis.

name: Lemon Essential Oil
odor_description: Fresh, bright, zesty citrus with clean, sparkling character
notes: Phototoxic. Must limit in leave-on products.

name: Lime Essential Oil (Distilled)
odor_description: Fresh, sharp citrus with candy-like sweetness
notes: Distilled version less phototoxic than expressed.

name: Grapefruit Essential Oil
odor_description: Fresh, bitter-sweet citrus with sulfurous, tropical notes
notes: Nootkatone gives characteristic grapefruit note.

name: Mandarin Essential Oil
odor_description: Sweet, tangy citrus with floral, honeyed undertones
notes: Sweeter than orange. Red mandarin has more anthranilate.

name: Bergamot Essential Oil
odor_description: Fresh citrus with floral, tea-like, slightly sweet notes
notes: Phototoxic (bergaptene). FCF version is bergaptene-free.

name: Yuzu Essential Oil
odor_description: Tart, zesty citrus with grapefruit and mandarin aspects
notes: Japanese citrus. Popular in modern perfumery.

name: Blood Orange Essential Oil
odor_description: Sweet orange with raspberry-berry undertones
notes: Unique berry note from anthocyanin pigments.

name: Apple Accord (Green)
odor_description: Fresh, green, crisp apple with slightly floral notes
notes: Green apple = more hexyl acetate. Red apple = more damascenone.

name: Peach Accord
odor_description: Sweet, fuzzy, juicy peach with lactonic undertones
notes: Lactones are key to peach character.

name: Apricot Accord
odor_description: Sweet, honey-like, slightly floral peach variant
notes: More honeyed than peach, with almond note from benzaldehyde.

name: Pear Accord
odor_description: Fresh, sweet, juicy with green and floral nuances
notes: Ethyl decadienoate is the key pear ester.

name: Plum Accord
odor_description: Sweet, rich, jammy with prune-like depth
notes: Damascenone gives characteristic ripe plum note.

name: Cherry Accord
odor_description: Sweet, almond-like, with red fruit juiciness
notes: Benzaldehyde dominates. Eugenol adds spicy warmth.

name: Mango Accord
odor_description: Tropical, sweet, with terpenic and sulfurous notes
notes: Terpenes give characteristic green-tropical note.

name: Papaya Accord
odor_description: Musky, tropical, creamy with slight sulfurous note
notes: Isothiocyanate gives characteristic papaya note.

name: Passion Fruit Accord
odor_description: Intense tropical, sulfurous, with catty and exotic notes
notes: Sulfur compounds give unique exotic character.

name: Pineapple Accord
odor_description: Sweet, tangy, tropical with ethyl ester freshness
notes: Allyl hexanoate and ethyl butyrate are key.

name: Coconut Accord
odor_description: Creamy, sweet, lactonic with suntan lotion quality
notes: Lactones create the classic coconut character.

name: Banana Accord
odor_description: Sweet, creamy, ripe banana with green peel notes
notes: Isoamyl acetate is the classic banana ester.

name: Fig Accord
odor_description: Green, milky, coconut-like with woody undertones
notes: Stemone and lactones give milky-green character.

name: Lychee Accord
odor_description: Sweet, floral, rose-like with citrus and grape notes
notes: Rose alcohols give characteristic lychee-rose connection.

name: Watermelon Accord
odor_description: Fresh, aquatic, green with sweet melon notes
notes: Calone gives marine/melon quality.

name: Melon Accord
odor_description: Sweet, green, slightly musky cantaloupe character
notes: Nonenal aldehydes are key melon compounds.

name: Blackcurrant Bud Absolute
odor_description: Green, catty, sulfurous, with fruity and woody notes
notes: Catty/sulfurous note from mercaptans. Used in small amounts.

name: Raspberry Accord
odor_description: Sweet, jammy, with floral and slightly green notes
notes: Raspberry ketone (frambinone) is key character impact compound.

name: Strawberry Accord
odor_description: Sweet, ripe, juicy with green and caramellic notes
notes: Furaneol is key. Ethyl methylphenylglycidate (strawberry aldehyde) adds character.

name: Blueberry Accord
odor_description: Sweet, slightly floral, with green and wine-like notes
notes: More subtle than other berries. Floral-fruity character.

name: Grape Accord (Concord)
odor_description: Sweet, foxy, musky grape with floral undertones
notes: Methyl anthranilate gives Concord grape character.

name: Pomegranate Accord
odor_description: Tart, fruity, with rose and raspberry notes
notes: Complex mix of floral and berry notes.

name: Tomato Leaf Accord
odor_description: Intense green, herbaceous, with earthy and slightly sweet notes
notes: 2-isobutylthiazole is the key tomato leaf compound.

name: Cucumber Accord
odor_description: Fresh, green, slightly melon-like and aquatic
notes: Nonadienal is the classic cucumber aldehyde.

name: Carrot Seed Essential Oil
odor_description: Earthy, woody, dry, with iris-like and violet notes
notes: Surprisingly orris-like. Used in chypres.

name: Celery Seed Absolute
odor_description: Green, herbaceous, with aromatic and slightly sweet notes
notes: Sedanolide is the characteristic celery compound.

name: Fennel Essential Oil
odor_description: Sweet, anise-like, with green and slightly camphoraceous notes
notes: Estragole content makes it IFRA restricted.

name: Rhubarb Accord
odor_description: Tart, green, fruity with earthy and slightly sour notes
notes: Tart green-fruit character. Popular in modern perfumery.

name: Eucalyptus Essential Oil
odor_description: Fresh, camphoraceous, with medicinal and cooling notes
notes: Eucalyptol (cineole) is the dominant component.

name: Camphor Essential Oil
odor_description: Sharp, medicinal, penetrating with cooling sensation
notes: White camphor is safest fraction.

name: Bell Pepper (Green) Accord
odor_description: Fresh, green, slightly earthy with vegetable character
notes: Pyrazine is extremely powerful. Use at ppm levels.

name: Ginger Essential Oil
odor_description: Warm, spicy, fresh with citrus and woody notes
notes: Fresh ginger has citrus notes. Dried is more woody.

name: Galangal Essential Oil
odor_description: Spicy, ginger-like, with eucalyptus and camphor notes
notes: More camphoraceous than ginger.

name: Saffron Absolute
odor_description: Warm, honeyed, hay-like, with leathery and metallic notes
notes: One of the most expensive spices. Safranal is key.

name: Black Pepper Essential Oil
odor_description: Warm, spicy, woody with fresh, slightly floral top
notes: Piperine provides the heat but is not volatile.

name: Pink Pepper Essential Oil
odor_description: Fruity, rosy, spicy with berry-like sweetness
notes: Not related to black pepper. More fruity character.

name: Thyme Essential Oil
odor_description: Warm, herbaceous, medicinal, with green and slightly sweet notes
notes: Red thyme has more thymol. White thyme is redistilled.

name: Basil Essential Oil
odor_description: Fresh, sweet, herbaceous with anise and clove notes
notes: Estragole content varies by chemotype.

name: Sage Essential Oil
odor_description: Herbaceous, camphoraceous, with eucalyptus notes
notes: Thujone content limits usage.

name: Rosemary Essential Oil
odor_description: Fresh, herbaceous, camphoraceous with woody undertones
notes: Different chemotypes: cineole, camphor, verbenone.

name: Spearmint Essential Oil
odor_description: Fresh, sweet, minty, less pungent than peppermint
notes: Carvone gives characteristic spearmint note.

name: Peppermint Essential Oil
odor_description: Fresh, strong, cooling minty with sweet undertones
notes: Menthol gives the cooling sensation.
